# Copilot Instructions

Follow the repository-wide rules in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and the
engineering constitution in [`openspec/constitution.md`](../openspec/constitution.md).
Before making changes, inspect the active OpenSpec proposal, capability deltas,
design, and tasks.

This project uses spec-driven development. Update the spec before implementation,
obtain human approval at the stated gate, implement one task at a time, verify
it, and only archive completed and approved changes. The current bootstrap
change is Phase A documentation only; do not write application code until Phase
B is explicitly approved.

Do not invent assessment content or diagnosis/report logic. Preserve the layer
boundaries, single-adapter policy, student privacy rules, Hebrew RTL experience,
and cloud portability requirements in the OpenSpec constitution.
